name: Image
description: A single framed photo with an optional caption and link, at a chosen aspect ratio and page width.

fields.name: Image
fields.helpText: Alt text is required unless Decorative is on. Honours the focal point and zoom.

fields.name: Decorative
fields.helpText: Renders the image with alt="" for a photo that carries no meaning of its own.

fields.name: Aspect ratio
fields.helpText: 3x2 is the default. auto keeps the image's own ratio uncropped.

fields.name: Link label
fields.helpText: Not shown on the page — the link's accessible name is the image's own alt text, so write that alt text as a destination.
